environment: Claude Code cloud container used only as a development tool; Linux, Node.js 22, local headless Chromium 1194

checks.skip_reason: Opt-in browser review, export and player tests; run separately with MOTION_REVIEW_BROWSER

checks.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_codex_install.py
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_package_identity.py
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_gepa_studio_pilot.py (optional GEPA dependency installed)

boundary: Source checks and one local mux test; whether ChatGPT asks about sound and avoids code-synthesized audio is not verified until an owner test. All 201 planned cases remain not_run.

runs.mux_command: the documented ffmpeg mux on the test D ChatGPT MP4 with a synthetic 120 BPM click track: one AAC stream, 6.00 s, video stream byte-identical, clicks sample-exact (first at 0.0 ms); with adelay=1000 the first click at 1000.0 ms and the stream starting at 0 s; -itsoffset only moved the stream start to 0.978 s
runs.rules: sound policy and stale-sentence cleanup are instruction changes; source checks only
